events.title: Self Defense Class with Underdog Martial Arts
events.description: Join Dirt Skrrts for an hour at Underdog Martial Arts for an informative self defense class with other women. Space for 20, open to all women.

events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in and around Old Fort. Note: this location does not allow e-bikes. Open to all women. Sign up goes live Thursday, October 1 at 7 pm.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Pisgah. Note: this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). Open to all women. Sign up goes live Sunday, November 1 at 7 pm.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Hot Springs. Note: this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). Open to all women. Sign up goes live Tuesday, December 1 at 7 pm.
